completion_scope: Comparator-relative score completed for scoreable cells; failed or missing cells are explicit NA and are never encoded as zero metrics.

zebrafish.decision_rule: submit full CPU only when linear pilot estimate is <= 604800 seconds
zebrafish.interpretation: resource-limited deployment datum; no full-genome CPU run was submitted and no scientific score is implied

chicken.input_contract: fixed source FASTA; no labels, score, or chromosome selection used by inference

model.threshold_policy: existing frozen CAL threshold; no refit on either whole genome

runtime_contract.dtype_policy: load checkpoint dtype; no autocast or BF16/FP16 conversion

cpu_policy: A CPU full-genome row is added only after a terminal native run; a pilot or extrapolation is never a measured whole-genome runtime. Explicit resource-gate decisions are reported separately under cpu_feasibility

d_exposure_audit.definition: D-independent chromosomes are fixed before score inspection by excluding every chromosome observed in the D TRAIN, CAL, and model-selection DEV manifests. This is a conservative chromosome-level exposure audit; any unresolved homologous or historical exposure is reported as a retrospective annotation caveat.
d_exposure_audit.independent_test_rule: Only chromosomes explicitly listed under independent_test are used for the D-independent accuracy stratum. Whole-assembly native discovery and timing still use the complete FASTA, and D class is N/A because the frozen D output is binary material inference.
d_exposure_audit.independent_test_selection_rationale: chr10 and chr20 were fixed before reading native outputs or scores because they are present primary assembly chromosomes, absent from every observed D TRAIN/CAL/DEV manifest for the corresponding species, and long enough to provide a non-trivial accuracy stratum. No chromosome was selected by model performance or label density.

chicken.unknown_policy: Unknown, '?' and ARTEFACT rows are retained as an audit stratum and excluded from both positive truth and negative callable truth

zebrafish.unknown_policy: Unknown, '?' and ARTEFACT rows are retained as an audit stratum and excluded from both positive truth and negative callable truth

native_class_evaluation.reason: Native class/family counts and Unknown coverage are retained for audit. This binary score does not claim class precision, recall, or a class confusion matrix; D has no class output.

library.class_field: FASTA first-token suffix after #; absent suffix is Unknown

native_material_parsers.EDTA: annotation.gff3: EDTA repeat_region/material rows; child subfeatures are not double-counted and rRNA/target-site rows are excluded
native_material_parsers.RM2: annotation.out: retain LINE/SINE/LTR/DNA/RC/Retroposon and Unknown class rows; exclude Simple_repeat, Low_complexity, Satellite, RNA and other non-TE classes

secondary_historical_strata.use: Retrospective reporting strata only. These chromosomes are not asserted to be independent of the D model because the SF5 split is not the D checkpoint exposure manifest.

strata_contract: Each species has its own whole_assembly and D-independent_test strata; no chromosome from another species is scored under its name
truth_boundary: No method receives labels. Same-assembly RepeatMasker output is a comparator layer; source-dependent or incomplete labels do not support an exhaustive whole-genome truth claim.
unknown_policy: Unknown, '?', and ARTEFACT comparator rows remain reported and are excluded from both positive truth and negative callable truth; known non-TE rows remain eligible negatives
